_comment: Kimi — the product-discovery conversation on the homepage. Flags and every visitor-facing string live here so marketing can change the words and the team can switch a piece off without touching next/kimi-flow.js. {name}, {first}, {email}, {product}, {need}, {capability} are filled at render time. The on-page persona stays 'Stagwell AI'; Kimi is the internal name of the conversation engine and the primary model behind it.

copy.intro: What are you trying to solve?

goalAck.brand_awareness: Brand awareness — good. A couple of quick questions so I point you at the right thing.
goalAck.audience_growth: Growing the audience — got it. A couple of quick questions first.
goalAck.reputation: Protecting reputation — understood. Two quick questions so I can narrow this down.
goalAck.competition: Tracking the competition — good. Let me narrow down what you need most.
goalAck.brand_impact: Measuring brand impact — got it. A couple of quick questions first.
goalAck.operations: Scaling operations — understood. Let me find the right fit.

copy.freeTextAck: Got it. A couple of quick questions so I recommend the right thing.
copy.fallback: I can still help. Which of these is closest to what you're trying to solve?
copy.unclassified: I didn't catch a marketing or business problem in that. Which of these is closest?
copy.moreDetail: Tell me a little more about what you're trying to do.
copy.contactTransition: I've narrowed this down to a strong fit. Tell me where to send the recommendation and I'll connect you with the right Stagwell AI team.
copy.contactNotice: We use these details to send your recommendation and so the right Stagwell AI team can follow up. See our privacy notice.

contactErrors.name: Your name, so we know who to ask for.
contactErrors.email: That does not look like a business email — check the address.
contactErrors.phone: That does not look like a phone number — check it.
contactErrors.failed: That didn't go through. Try again in a moment.

copy.recommendationIntroLow: Thanks, {first}. From what you've told me, here's where I'd start:
copy.afterCards: A Stagwell AI specialist will also follow up at {email}.
copy.afterCardsPhone: A Stagwell AI specialist will also follow up at {email} or on {phone}.
copy.composerClosed: Your recommendation is above — we'll be in touch.
copy.whyFits: {product} is the strongest fit because you want to {need}. It covers {capabilities}.
copy.whyFitsNoNeed: {product} is the closest fit for what you've described. It covers {capabilities}.
copy.multiCta: Talk to a Stagwell AI expert

hints.start: What do you need help solving?
hints.question: Pick one, or type your answer…
